evidence.support_text: The Weight of Evidence No Expected Sensitization Induction Level (NESIL) for 2-methyl-3-(p-isopropylphenyl)propionaldehyde is 5900 µg/cm², based on the MT-NOEL from human studies and limited to two significant figures.

evidence.support_text: In the data summary for 3-methyl-2-(pentyloxy)cyclopent-2-en-1-one, the HRIPT NOEL (induction) was 1181 µg/cm² and the WoE NESIL was 1100 µg/cm².

evidence.experimental_conditions: Weight of evidence from structural analysis, human studies, and read-across analogs (11-tridecen-6-one, 8,12-dimethyl- and tetrahydro-pseudo-ionone)
evidence.support_text: Based on the weight of evidence (WoE) from structural analysis, human studies, and read-across analogs 11-tridecen-6-one, 8,12-dimethyl- (CAS # 68141-18-4) and tetrahydro-pseudo-ionone (CAS # 1322-58-3), 6,10-dimethylundeca-5,9-dien-2-one is a weak sensitizer with a WoE NESIL of 9400 µg/cm² (see Table 1).
